info.name: Data AVAX Supply Primary Network Blocks API

params.name: blockchainId
params.description: A primary network blockchain id or alias.

params.name: blockId
params.description: A block identifier which is either a block number or the block hash.

items.docs: Gets a block by block height or block hash on one of the Primary Network chains.

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: Query param for retrieving items after a specific timestamp.

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: Query param for retrieving items before a specific timestamp.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.
